verdict.rationale: The SDK repo documents a native integration with LangChain Python and JS, and shows OpenAI SDK instrumentation via `wrap_openai(openai.Client())`. The docs list ready-made integrations for OpenAI, the Vercel AI SDK, Anthropic, CrewAI and Pydantic AI, with OpenTelemetry as a fallback for other stacks, and a community user confirms the LangChain integration is fairly turnkey. missing for 10: Vercel AI SDK setup is only named in an integrations list with no detailed docs, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation of the OpenAI or Vercel integrations.
